column1: # Claims of the notice sections in docs/concepts/heads.md.
element
under oneshot a console's program is not started again, and the console ends
the oneshot notice names the roaming chord when no other console of the head runs
the oneshot notice names the console chord when another console of the head runs
the oneshot notice shows while the ended console is shown
oneshot is off by default
Ctrl-Super-Right is the console chord's key for the next console
Ctrl-Super-Up is the roaming chord's key for the next head
a console the open chord opened whose session cannot start leaves, with a notice and a log line
the console-not-opened notice, word for word
an exit within 2 seconds of the start is quick
more than 5 quick exits in a row end the run
under open the crash loop exits with status 1; under closed vtium hangs every session up, darkens the heads' displays and keeps the VT
the boot display shows the stopped notice for as long as vtium runs
the stopped notice, word for word
a stopped seat delivers no input, the VT keys included
a valid closed file whose heads have no display shows No head has a connected display
a head whose display never lit receives no keys
an isolated head's keyboards never switch VTs
